title: KChime Dashboard Metric Definitions
description: Metric queries and cohort definitions for PostHog / Amplitude / Datadog dashboards. All queries reference only the event names and property keys defined in event-schema.json.

dimensions.device_id_hash: Consistent anonymous device identifier (SHA-256 truncated). Stable within a device; resets on app reinstall.
dimensions.tone_profile: Selected tone at time of event (Professional | Friendly | Direct | Custom).

activation.description: Percentage of new installs that complete the full onboarding and fire their first generation within 24 hours.

definition.numerator: distinct device_id_hash where onboarding_completed AND generation_completed fired within same calendar day
definition.denominator: distinct device_id_hash where app_opened with is_first_launch=true

dau.description: Daily Active Users — distinct devices that fire at least one generation_completed per day.

wau.description: Weekly Active Users — rolling 7-day window of distinct devices with generation_completed.

dau_wau_ratio.description: Stickiness ratio — DAU / WAU. Target > 0.20 indicates healthy daily habit formation.

retention_cohorts.description: Day-N retention measured from the device's first onboarding_completed event.

conversion_funnel.description: Full funnel from install to paid subscriber.

onboarding_drop_off.description: Step-by-step completion rate within the onboarding funnel.
onboarding_drop_off.note: Break at keyboard_setup is expected to be higher — enabling a keyboard extension has OS friction.

generation_success_rate.description: Percentage of generation_completed events where success=true.

p50_p95_latency.description: Median and 95th-percentile generation latency from generation_completed.latency_ms.

paywall_conversion_rate.description: Percentage of paywall_viewed events followed by subscription_started within 30 minutes.
paywall_conversion_rate.numerator: subscription_started within 30 min of paywall_viewed on same device

rewrite_chip_block_rate.description: Percentage of Pro chip taps (is_pro_chip=true) blocked due to free tier. High rate = conversion opportunity.

promise_set_rate.description: Percentage of detected promise banners confirmed (vs dismissed). Measures reminder feature stickiness.

generation_per_dau.description: Average number of generations per active device per day. Tracks habit depth.

feature_breakdown.description: Split of generation_completed by feature (keyboard vs share_extension).

tone_profile_distribution.description: Distribution of tone_profile across generation_completed. Shows default preferences.

generation_success_rate_drop.action: Page on-call — likely AI provider outage

dau_drop.action: Check App Store reviews and crash reports
